Problem.content: Membangun benchmark FinRAGBench-V dan baseline RGenCite untuk RAG multimodal dengan visual citation.
Problem.quote: Our task contains two main phases: the construction of FinRAGBench-V, and the implementation of the RGenCite baseline

Domain & Data.content: Domain keuangan, mencakup laporan riset, laporan keuangan, prospektus, makalah akademik, dan majalah finansial; data dikumpulkan dari Qianzhan.com, FinGLM, BSCF, jurnal, dan Financial Times; ukuran besar dan berbahasa Inggris serta Mandarin.
Domain & Data.quote: Financial statements of companies and banks collected from the FinGLM dataset and official company and bank websites

RAG Method.content: Menggunakan retriever teksual (Jina-ColBERT-V2, Multilingual-E5-large) dan multimodal (ColQwen2, GME-Qwen2-VL-2B, DSE-QWen2-2b-MRL-V1); chunking pada level halaman; generator memakai MLLM seperti GPT-4o, GPT-4V, Gemini-2.0-Flash, Qwen2.5-VL-72B-Instruct; visual citation diintegrasikan pada tahap generasi.
RAG Method.quote: we develop the baseline system RGenCite, which covers both retrieval and generation, with visual citation seamlessly integrated into the generation stage

Evaluation & Metrics.content: Evaluasi mencakup retrieval (nDCG@k, Recall@k, MRR@k), akurasi jawaban (ROUGE, ACC), serta kualitas visual citation (precision, recall pada level halaman dan blok, IoU, dan penilaian manusia 0–5).
Evaluation & Metrics.quote: we adopt several evaluation metrics, namely nDCG@k (for k = 5, 10), Recall@k (for k = 5, 10), and MRR@k (k = 10)

Main Results.content: Multimodal retriever mencapai recall@10 hingga 90.13 % (Chinese) dan 85.86 % (English), jauh di atas retriever teksual (42.71 %/36.36 %). Visual citation dengan image‑cropping memperoleh korelasi Pearson 65.06 dengan IoU dan 68.01 dengan penilaian manusia.
Main Results.quote: ColQwen2 achieves a recall@10 of 90.13 (Chinese) and 85.86 (English)

Limitations.content: Tidak melatih model khusus multimodal RAG untuk domain keuangan; benchmark berbahasa Inggris dan Mandarin, tidak mencakup bahasa Indonesia; belum mengatasi kebutuhan abstention.
Limitations.quote: we did not train a dedicated model for multimodal RAG in the financial domain

Gap.content: Penulis menyatakan belum melatih model khusus untuk RAG multimodal keuangan dan benchmark berbahasa Inggris/Mandarin, sehingga tidak mencakup dokumen perbankan berbahasa Indonesia atau evaluasi abstention. Inferensi: Karena tidak ada evaluasi faithfulness atau mekanisme abstention pada dokumen perbankan berbahasa Indonesia, gap penelitian tetap ada.

Although evaluation metrics for retrieval and generation are well-established, visual citation, as a novel application within RAG, still lacks dedicated evaluation methodologies. To address this gap, we propose an automatic evaluation method for vi- sual citation. Specifically, we define the evalua- tion metrics, precision and recall, at both the page- level and block-level, and introduce two evaluation strategies: box-bounding and image-cropping. We conduct extensive experiments and evalua- tions on FinRAGBench-V. Accordingly, we adopt GPT-4o with image-cropping in our experiments. 8 Conclusion In this paper, we introduce FinRAGBench-V, a benchmark designed for multimodal RAG with vi- sual citations in the financial domain, covering a retrieval corpus collected from diverse real-world financial documents and a QA dataset focusing on a wide range of financial tasks. Through extensive experiments, FinRAGBench-V exposes limitations of MLLMs and serves as a valuable resource to guide future improvements in visual RAG systems. Limitations Despite
